d: Inside the terrifying secret race between Washington, Beijing, and Moscow. Military commanders across the globe have deployed autonomous artificial intelligence. Some are being linked into nuclear early-warning networks, submarine tracking systems, and strategic command bunkers. Experts and UN warn that a single machine hallucination, algorithmic failure, or covert cyberstrike could misread ordinary sensor data as an all-out nuclear launch. With 12,187 nuclear weapons ready across the globe, humanity sits on the edge of a doomsday. Ahead of the crucial APEC summit, Donald Trump, Xi…
